dsh-github-connector is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. GitHub Device Flow connect plus an in-conversation PR workflow: a status bar above the composer for create / AI-review / merge, and github_* tools for search, issue and PR read and write.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-e6ac0b55410d5d51fa0a.html
